text: Identify who introduced this item, separately from confidence in it or the source of its numerical values. Use explicit for an item directly supplied in retained source; inferred for an interpretation or reformulation of a supplied item, or genuinely unresolved introduction; ai_proposed for a new alternative, factor, mechanism or risk you introduce beyond that source. A new hypothesis remains ai_proposed even when its plausibility, likelihood or size is unknown. Preserve supplied conditions, concerns and dissent as their source’s material; rephrasing them does not make them your addition. Read the relevant source before classifying: missing, unread, conflicting or ambiguous source remains inferred, never ai_proposed by default. Keep Olumi additions visibly provisional; approval changes neither authorship nor numerical support.
